q1.question: How can I publish my property on RentUs?
q1.answer: It's very simple. Register as an owner, go to your dashboard, and select 'Publish Property'. Complete the basic data, upload high-quality photos, and you're done! Our team will review the information to activate it.

q2.question: What payment methods can I use?
q2.answer: We accept credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express). You can also link your bank account for automatic recurring payments through our secure platform.

q3.question: How do digital contracts work?
q3.answer: All our contracts are legally binding and signed electronically. Once both parties accept the terms, the system generates a certified PDF that you can download at any time from your 'Contracts' section.

q4.question: How do I report a technical problem in the property?
q4.answer: If you are a tenant, go to the 'Maintenance' section in your user menu. There you can create a detailed report with photos, which will go directly to the owner or administrator for management.

q5.question: Is it safe to share my personal data?
q5.answer: Absolutely. At RentUs, we use bank-grade encryption (SSL) to protect all your sensitive information. We never share your data with third parties without your explicit consent.

q6.question: Can I cancel my contract early?
q6.answer: Early cancellation depends on the specific clauses agreed upon in your digital contract. We recommend reviewing the 'Termination' section in your current contract or contacting the owner directly.

identification.title: 1. Application Identification
identification.content:
RENTUS is a digital Software as a Service (SaaS) platform designed for the comprehensive management of real estate assets, facilitating connection and communication between owners, landlords, and tenants.

Use of this application implies full acceptance of the terms described herein.

usage.title: 2. Conditions of Use
usage.content:
The user agrees to make lawful, diligent, and correct use of the platform. The following are prohibited:

  • Using the system for fraudulent or illegal purposes.
  • Impersonating other users or providing false property information.
  • Interfering with the technical operation of RENTUS servers.

responsibilities.title: 3. User Responsibilities
responsibilities.content:
Owners/Landlords: They are responsible for the truthfulness of the information regarding published properties and for possessing the legal rights for their marketing.

Tenants: They are responsible for the truthfulness of their personal and financial information provided for lease applications.

liability.title: 4. Limitations of Liability
liability.content:
RENTUS acts as a technological facilitator. We are not a party to the final contractual relationship between landlord and tenant, nor are we responsible for:

  • Non-payment by tenants.
  • Physical damage to properties.
  • 100% uninterrupted service availability (although we work to guarantee 99.9%).

intellectual.title: 5. Intellectual Property
intellectual.content: The software, design, logos, texts, and architecture of RENTUS are the exclusive property of its original developers. Total or partial reproduction is prohibited without express written authorization.

termination.title: 6. Suspension and Cancellation
termination.content: RENTUS reserves the right to suspend or cancel user accounts that violate these terms, engage in spam, or use the platform for suspicious fraudulent activities.

responsible.title: 1. Data Controller
responsible.content: RENTUS is responsible for the processing of personal data collected through this platform, ensuring compliance with Law 1581 of 2012 on the Protection of Personal Data in Colombia.

dataCollected.title: 2. Data Collected
dataCollected.content:
We collect the following information necessary for real estate management:

  • Personal Data: Name, ID document, email, phone.
  • Property Data: Address, photos, tradition certificate, services.
  • Financial Data: Payment history and payment methods (processed through secure gateways).

purpose.title: 3. Purpose of Processing
purpose.content:
Your data is used exclusively for:

  • Managing digital lease agreements.
  • Processing rent collection and payments.
  • Facilitating technical and administrative communication between parties.
  • Generating statistical maintenance and financial reports.

security.title: 4. Storage and Security
security.content: Information is stored in high-security cloud infrastructures with 256-bit SSL encryption and daily backups to ensure the integrity of your sensitive assets.

providers.title: 5. External Providers
providers.content: RENTUS uses trusted third-party services (e.g., payment gateways and cloud storage services) to operate. These providers only have access to the minimum necessary information and comply with high security standards.

rights.title: 6. User Rights
rights.content: You have the right to know, update, rectify, and delete your personal data at any time through the Settings section or by contacting our support team.

retention.title: 7. Data Retention
retention.content: We will retain your data as long as you maintain an active account or for the time required by applicable tax and commercial laws for the validity of signed contracts.
